title: Sports Terms, Trophies and Venues: Quiz

questions.question: The term 'googly' is associated with which sport?
questions.rationale: A googly is the leg-spinner's ball that spins the 'wrong' way — the invention credited to B.J.T. Bosanquet in cricket's golden age.

questions.question: 'Love' and 'deuce' are terms from:
questions.rationale: Love (zero) and deuce (40-40) belong to tennis scoring, alongside 'ace' and 'tie-break' — the game's whole vocabulary in two words.

questions.question: The Durand Cup is associated with:
questions.rationale: First held in 1888, it is Asia's oldest football tournament — older than every other Indian trophy in the options.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is competed for in:
questions.rationale: The Thomas Cup is the men's international team badminton trophy; the Uber Cup is its women's counterpart — the most-swapped pair in sports GK.

questions.question: India won its first Thomas Cup title in:
questions.rationale: India beat Indonesia 3-0 in the 2022 final at Bangkok — the country's first men's team world title in badminton.

questions.question: Which Grand Slam tournament is played on clay courts?
questions.rationale: Roland Garros (the French Open) is the only clay major; Wimbledon is the only grass one. The surface question is the safest mark on the paper.

questions.question: The Ryder Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.rationale: Golf's Ryder Cup pits Europe against the USA — the team-event exception in an otherwise individual sport.

questions.question: Lord's cricket ground, 'the home of cricket', is located in:
questions.rationale: Lord's sits in St John's Wood, London. The MCG (Melbourne) is the decoy carrying the capacity superlative instead.

questions.question: Which of the following is India's officially declared national game?
questions.rationale: India has no officially declared national game — the Sports Ministry clarified this through an RTI reply in 2012. 'Hockey' is folklore, not law.

questions.question: The Nehru Trophy is associated with:
questions.rationale: The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is held on Punnamada Lake at Alappuzha (Alleppey) in Kerala, with the chundan vallam snake-boats.
